q1.display: 6 stops of 30+ minutes (Data Issue corrected); raw system state: 7
q1.sql:
SELECT minute_start, planned, running, pieces FROM machine_minutes WHERE company_id = :tenant AND machine_id = :machine AND minute_start >= :start AND minute_start < :end ORDER BY minute_start, id;
SELECT DISTINCT reason_date || ' ' || hour_start AS hour_ts, reason, minutes, remark, entered_by, created_at FROM stop_reasons WHERE company_id = :tenant AND machine_id = :machine AND deleted_at = '0000-00-00 00:00:00' AND reason_date || ' ' || hour_start >= :start AND reason_date || ' ' || hour_start < :end
q1.logic: classify minutes -> runs of STOPPED_PLANNED -> keep runs >= 30 -> apply D4 rule (UNCHANGED/ELIMINATED/AMBIGUOUS)
caveats: Plant day = 08:00 to 08:00 next morning. A stop crossing 20:00 or midnight counts once.
A stop is a run of consecutive planned minutes with running = 0. A missing minute (no data) ends a run.

Data Issue correction uses live, de-duplicated operator entries. Entries give minutes per hour, not which minutes, so a stop is only removed when the entries provably leave it shorter than 30 minutes.
Calendar-day reading of the question would give a different count (owner question).
Data Issue entries used: 2, last created at 2026-11-04 11:44:24. The answer is valid as of the snapshot only.

sensitivity.name: raw_with_unknown_as_stopped
sensitivity.note: raw count (Data Issue NOT applied) if every missing minute were a planned stop

q5.logic: for each machine of the tenant: collapse exact duplicate minute rows, sum pieces over the plant-day window, add up machines

q6.display: Breakdown (1869 real lost minutes entered by operators)
q6.sql: WITH live AS (  SELECT DISTINCT company_id, machine_id, reason_date, hour_start, reason, minutes,                   COALESCE(remark, '') AS remark, COALESCE(entered_by, '') AS entered_by, created_at  FROM stop_reasons   WHERE company_id = ? AND deleted_at = ? AND reason_date >= ? AND reason_date <= ?) SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n_entries, SUM(minutes) AS total_minutes FROM live GROUP BY reason ORDER BY total_minutes DESC
q6.logic: collapse exact live duplicate rows -> exclude Data Issue (machine was actually running) -> rank remaining stop reasons by sum(minutes)
caveats: Live entries only (deleted_at = '0000-00-00 00:00:00'); exact duplicate rows collapsed to one.
'Data Issue' entries indicate the machine was actually running (false system stop) and are excluded from real lost time.
Filtered by operator-entered reason_date (calendar date).
Data Issue accounted for 3974 entered minutes across 103 entries (excluded).

q8.display: 44 stop-reason entries created > 24h after described hour end (out of 733 total entries)
q8.sql: WITH live AS (  SELECT DISTINCT company_id, machine_id, reason_date, hour_start, reason, minutes,                   COALESCE(remark, '') AS remark, COALESCE(entered_by, '') AS entered_by, created_at  FROM stop_reasons   WHERE company_id = ? AND deleted_at = ? AND reason_date >= ? AND reason_date <= ?) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_entries,        SUM(strftime('%s', created_at) - strftime('%s', datetime(reason_date || ' ' || hour_start, '+1 hour')) > 86400) AS late_entries FROM live
q8.logic: collapse exact live duplicate rows -> compute seconds elapsed from described hour end to created_at -> count entries strictly > 86400 seconds (24h)
caveats: Hour end is reason_date + hour_start + 1 hour. Lateness is strictly > 24 hours (86400 seconds).
Entries appearing twice are counted once via deduplication.
Live rows only (deleted_at = '0000-00-00 00:00:00').

q9.sql: WITH live AS (  SELECT DISTINCT company_id, machine_id, reject_date, hour_start, qty, defect, created_at   FROM rejections   WHERE company_id = ? AND deleted_at = ? AND reject_date = ?) SELECT defect, SUM(qty) AS qty, COUNT(*) AS n_entries FROM live GROUP BY defect ORDER BY qty DESC
q9.logic: collapse exact live duplicate rejection rows for reject_date -> sum qty across all defect types
caveats: Live rows only (deleted_at = '0000-00-00 00:00:00'); exact duplicate rows collapsed to one.
Filtered on calendar reject_date = '2026-11-02' (profiling showed reject_date is a calendar date).
'No Rejection' records with qty = 0 are included in entries but contribute 0 to count.

q10.display: 3 machines running at snapshot time (Press 2, Bender 1, Moulder 2)
q10.sql: SELECT m.machine_id, m.name, mm.planned, mm.running, mm.pieces FROM machines m LEFT JOIN machine_minutes mm   ON m.company_id = mm.company_id AND m.machine_id = mm.machine_id AND mm.minute_start = ? WHERE m.company_id = ? ORDER BY m.machine_id
q10.logic: query tenant latest minute -> join machine_minutes at that minute for each machine -> return machines with running = 1
caveats: 'Now' is defined by the latest available timestamp in the tenant's snapshot (2026-11-07 14:36:00), not the server wall-clock time.
A machine is considered running only if it has a live record at that exact minute with running = 1.
All tenant machines had a recorded state at the snapshot minute.
